text:
named_risk: re-derivation at a new path has no last_known_rules, so AR86-C6's never-weaker protection does not
    apply; mitigate by taking the union with the T2-verified lineage-bound document's RULES while minting a FRESH
    identity
historical_rule_source:
  verdict: HISTORICAL_RULE_SOURCE_REUSES_EXISTING_PROOF_GRADE_PRIMITIVE
  record: release/orchestration/phase-2/RESEARCH/P2-HISTORICAL-RULE-SOURCE.md
  orchestrator_error_corrected_by_owner: the orchestrator proposed inheriting rules from the T2-verified document;
    OD-P2-08 section 2 makes the T2 seal detection, never proof-grade. Proposal withdrawn; the document is not consulted
    for rules at all.
  source: FloorIdentity::last_known_rules under srr::state::resolve_state_root()/adoption-floors/ -- protected machine
    state, outside every project, unreachable by an ordinary actor (AR88)
  association: NONE NEEDED -- the owner's conservative-union suggestion dissolves it. policy.rs's existing AR86-C6
    union is pattern-additive (if !fresh_patterns.contains(p)), so a union across all store entries can only ADD
    patterns the fresh derivation missed; no historical identity has to be declared owner of the new checkout.
  fail_closed: missing -> fresh derivation only (today's behaviour); wrong -> can only add patterns, i.e. restrict;
    conflicting -> fresh derivation wins, own classifications never displaced
  new_authority: none -- same store, same read helper, same native_layout_rules, same additive-union shape; one
    new enumeration, which is a read not an authority
  load_bearing_detail: the union must be applied in the derivation init/adopt hand to write_project_adoption_floor,
    not only in PolicySet::load's reconstruction, because once a floor is written reconstruction never fires and
    a weak derived floor would be promoted to authenticated
ar96_orchestrator_finding:
  status: WITHDRAWN -- the finding was wrong
  record: release/orchestration/phase-2/RESEARCH/P2-AR0096-POSITIVE-CONTROL-GAP.md
  why_wrong: execute_check's sandbox is git:true, which runs a fresh git init (sandbox.rs:113), so its lineage never
    matches the copied floor; read_project_adoption_floor returns early on lineage mismatch at paths.rs:1200, BEFORE
    reconcile and therefore before is_health_sandbox_root. The exemption is never consulted for an execute_check
    sandbox, so the builder's in-process probe matches the only production shape.
  self_lesson: second load-bearing claim this phase I got wrong by verifying that a path EXISTS without verifying
    that it REACHES the decision -- the same authority-vs-representation confusion the product keeps failing on.
    First was proposing the T2-verified document as a rules authority.
  real_adjacent_observation_for_review_8: inside a skills::execute_check scenario sandbox the project floor is ALWAYS
    refused on lineage, so scenario checks run with no floor applied at all -- AR84-C3-shaped, unrelated to the
    exemption, correctly out of scope for a bounded delta, but a judgement for Review 8
